name: long-running
description: Context discipline for multi-lane orchestration — ground truth arrives only as a lane's verdict, anything with a body is a lane, every wait folds into the lane that acts, no lane parks and no lane is re-briefed, state lives in cc-notes and the task list; ships an open-PR ledger CLI over cc-notes that grades, routes, and holds every open PR, and a landing-desk tool that queues lane reports, guards the merge label, and summarises landings for the root.
